name: Near Plane Clipping Correction
aliases: Inside-Volume Volume Rendering via Backface Raycasting
Near Plane Clipping Correction — Camera Inside Volume Handling
Near Plane Clipping Correction — Camera Inside Volume Handling, Inside-Volume Volume Rendering via Backface Raycasting, Near Plane Clipping Correction — Camera Inside Volume Handling
definition: Handling cases where the camera is inside the fluid volume and the near plane clips the front faces, which would otherwise cause incorrect ray entry points and depths.
summary: Near Plane Clipping Correction fixes rendering holes when the camera is inside a volume by intersecting rays with explicit geometry to determine correct entry points.
